2608.13545.title: LittleLearner: Language Models Under Pedagogically Controlled Knowledge Exposure
2608.13545.paper_summary: Modern language models are trained on heterogeneous web-scale text corpora. Consequently, studying knowledge and skill acquisition is difficult, as prior exposure to related content is hard to characterize. To address this challenge, we introduce LITTLECURRICULUM, a curated 88B-token pretraining corpus tailored to U.S. elementary school material, explicitly excluding concepts, facts, and vocabulary taught above Grade 5. Training a 5B-parameter LLM from scratch on LITTLECURRICULUM yields LITTLELEARNER, a model with sufficient language competence for open-ended evaluation, yet with clear knowledge and capability boundaries mapped to interpretable curriculum guidelines. We release LITTLECURRICULUM and LITTLELEARNER as a developmentally restricted sandbox to study how models acquire, represent, and use data under a well-defined training scope. We illustrate the sandbox's utility in a first suite of experiments on injecting new knowledge through post-training and in-context learning. These methods let LITTLELEARNER better utilize existing knowledge, but do not raise out-of-scope capabilities. Our findings underscore the value of this controlled environment for future investigations.
2608.13545.paper_summary_zh: 現代語言模型是在異質的網絡規模文本語料庫上進行訓練的。<lb/>因此，研究知識和技能的獲取變得困難，因為之前接觸相關內容的情況難以表徵。<lb/>為了解決這一挑戰，我們推出了LITTLECURRICULUM，一個精心策劃的88B-token預訓練語料庫，專為美國小學教材量身定制，明確排除了五年級以上教授的概念、事實和詞彙。<lb/>從頭開始在LITTLECURRICULUM上訓練一個5B參數的LLM產生了LITTLELEARNER，這是一個具有足夠語言能力以進行開放式評估的模型，但其知識和能力的邊界明確，並且映射到可解釋的課程指導方針上。<lb/>我們將LITTLECURRICULUM和LITTLELEARNER作為一個發展受限的沙盒釋放，以研究模型在明確的訓練範疇內如何獲取、表徵和使用數據。<lb/>我們在首次實驗中展示了這個沙盒的實用性，通過後訓練和上下文學習注入新知識。<lb/>這些方法使LITTLELEARNER能夠更好地利用現有知識，但不會提高超出範疇的能力。<lb/>我們的發現強調了這個受控環境對未來研究的價值。
